steps: Enter a local service address and find restaurants.
Search or filter the restaurant directory.
Choose size, spice level, extras, note, and quantity for an item.
Add the item and verify the server-backed cart.
Open checkout and review subtotal, tax, service fee, delivery fee, and total without submission.
Replace the query with a valid cuisine and recover results.
Remove the item at quantity zero and verify totals.
Submit display name, email and password to the site-bound local backend.
Use the local-sandbox verification code without external email.
Sign in again with the registered credentials and verify session restoration.
